text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, two girls from a foreign country were visiting the Landosol real estate agency.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とある日。
ランドソルの不動産屋を、
異国から来た二人の少女が訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Huuuuh?! What do you mean you can't rent us a place?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ええ！？
部屋は貸せないってどういうことですか！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I can pay the contract fee and the deposit fee. Rent's not an issue. I do have some savings, past that... guess we'll be living a very frugal life from now on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
契約金に敷金礼金。
当面の家賃も払えますよ。
いちお多少の蓄えはあるんで、
まあ
こっから鬼の節約生活ですけど。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Yes... And it's not like I won't make money myself. I may not look like it, but I'm a genius alchemist, so there are plenty of ways I can provide for ourselves...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ……
それに、
ちゃんとお金も稼ぎます。
私こう見えても天才錬金術師ですから
稼ぐ方法はいくらでも……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: She even managed to slip in a humble brag.
text_block_list.orig_text: さらっと自慢も入れます。

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: An alchemist...? Sounds shady. In the first place, kids like you can't sign rental contracts. At least, bring an adult with you next time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術師……？　
胡散臭いな。
そもそも賃貸契約は
子どもだけじゃ無理なんで。
せめて大人を連れてきなさい。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Eh, no, no? There's one right here. If you're looking for an adult, look he~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
いやいや？
いるじゃないですか、
大人ならここに──

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Crap. Right now, I'm actually in a kid's body... Mgh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しまった。
今私、
めっちゃ子どもの体……
むぐっ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, what are you saying, Sono-san...?! A-Ahaha, excuse us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
何言ってるのよソノさん……！
あ、
あはは、
失礼しま～す。

text_block_list.name: Real Estate Agent
text_block_list.text: ...A kid's body?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……子どもの体？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, Sono-san. Didn't we agree to keep your body exchange with Iroha-chan a secret?! If that gets out, its gonna turn into a huge mess...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょ、
ソノさんっ。
イロハちゃんとの入れ替わりのことは秘密にするって決めたでしょ！
バレちゃうと色々面倒なんだから……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Sorry about that... but what should we do? Not being able to get a place is a huge setback... There must be something we can do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こりゃ失敬……
ってか、
どうしよっか？
流石に家が借りられないのはいたすぎる。
なにか手はないかな……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...It's been almost a year since I switched bodies with Iroha. My back doesn't hurt, my shoulders don't feel heavy, my arms and legs don't get random cramps, I don't suffer from a mysterious migraine and no more low blood pressure mornings... her body is truly DIVINE. But at times like these, it's kind of rough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……イロハの体と入れ替わってそろそろ一年。
腰痛ないし、
肩のだる重も、
手足の冷えも、
謎の偏頭痛もない。
朝の低血圧とも無縁の
マジで神な体なんだけど、
こういう時きついな。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. That's right. Iroha's here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ、
そうだ。
イロハがいるじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: That girl has an adult body now, so let's have Iroha do it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子大人の体なんだから、
イロハにやってもらおうよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...No, I mean, she's still a crazy kid in the inside, you know. I wonder if Iroha-chan is even able to sign a rental contract...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いやでも
中身はめちゃくちゃ子どもだよ？
イロハちゃんに賃貸契約なんてできるのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, Rui-chan, what about alchemy? Can't alchemy do something good for us in this situation?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだルイちゃん、
錬金術は？
錬金術でなんかうまいことできない？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I see, that's a plan! Hehe, leave it all to this genius alchemist♪ So with that said.... COME OUT! Portable Alchemy Cauldron! Aaaaand...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
その手があったわ！
ふふ、
この天才錬金術師にお任せあれ♪
ってことで
出でよ
携帯錬金釜！　
からの～

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Okay, it's done! A "Bracelet-shaped Anesthetic Elixir" and a "Ribbon-shaped Voice Changer"! With this, we can now put Iroha-chan to sleep while you'll dub over her with your voice, Sono-san!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし完成！　
『ブレスレット型麻酔秘薬』と
『リボン型変声秘薬』よ！
これでイロハちゃんを眠らせて、
ソノさんが声を変えてしゃべれば！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's not do that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
それなんかやめとけ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: So, where's Iroha? She said grown-up talk was boring, so she should be nearby eating ice cream...
text_block_list.orig_text:
んで、
イロハは？　
大人のお話つまんないって、
この辺でアイス食べてるはずなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...She's not here, Sono-san? Wait... Is she lost?! Don't tell me she got dragged into something...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いないわよソノさん？
ちょ……
もしかして迷子に！？
まさか、
事件に巻き込まれちゃったとか……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: S-Stop it, that's only going to bring bad omens... As if Iroha would do something like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やめてよ
縁起悪い……
イロハに限ってそんなこと──

text_block_list.name: Men
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐぎゃあぁぁああ～～～っ！！

text_block_list.text: Ahaha~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: あははーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Sono & Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Iroha?!" "Iroha-chan!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
「イロハ！？」
「イロハちゃん！？」

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Rui-chan. I have a bad feeling about this, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ルイちゃん。
死ぬほど嫌な予感がすんだけど？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Me too! Let's go, Sono-san!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もよ！
行くわよソノさん！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You guys haven't trained at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あははっ！
修行がなってないな～、
おにーさんたち！

text_block_list.name: Royal Palace Knight 1
text_block_list.text: Gaha... We're the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE... and yet, twenty of us can't stand up to her?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
がは……っ。
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の騎士が……
20人がかりで歯が立たないだと？

text_block_list.name: Royal Palace Knight 2
text_block_list.text: Wh-What strength... Don't tell me this woman... Is she really on par with our Captain... or even the Vice-Captain... Gufu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
なんて強さだ……
まさかこの女……
うちの団長や副団長と
同等……
ぐふっ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wha-... Iroha-chan?! What's this? There's a bunch of armored soldiers laying around...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
イロハちゃん！？
なにこれ、
鎧の兵士が何人も……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah...! AAAAHHH.....!! What do you think you're doing!!? Causing trouble as soon as we get here......!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
ああ……っ！！
あんた何やってんのっ！！？
来るなり面倒事起こしやがって……っ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: I'm not causing any trouble! Hey, hey, wake up guys~ Iroha still hasn't had enough fun~
text_block_list.orig_text:
面倒なんて起こしてないよ！
ね
ね、
起きてよおにーさんたち～
イロハまだまだ遊び足りないよ～？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Come on. Can't we fight more?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら。
もっとやろ？

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: HIIIIIII!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひいいっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah! Iroha's gone into her battle crazed mode...! She won't stop until she gets bored of this...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っば、
イロハ戦闘狂モード入っちゃってる……！
これ
飽きるまで止まらんやつだ……っ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Leave her to me! Pishun!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私に任せて！
それ、
ピシュンっ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, no hesitation whatsoever... to use that "Bracelet-shaped Anesthetic Elixir" she made...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ、
躊躇いもなく、
『ブレスレット型麻酔秘薬』使った……

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... WHUURGH!!? ...Uuu... zzzzz...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
うっ！！？
……うう……
むにゃむにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: And now... she's out cold in a second...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして
秒で寝た……

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: Zzzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐうー……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Everyone's out cold...
text_block_list.orig_text: みんな寝るんかい……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. I actually just wanted to put Iroha-chan to sleep, but this effect is amazing! It seems I am so much of a genius that I over-succeeded!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふむ。
ほんとはイロハちゃんだけ眠らせたかったんだけど
効果すごいわね。
天才すぎて成功しすぎたわ！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, you just failed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
失敗な。

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: You there! What do you think you're doing?! Don't move!
text_block_list.orig_text:
貴様ら何をしている！！
動くな！！

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: Grrr... How dare you pull off this stunt in front of the royal castle?! Capture these criminals at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ
ぬう……
王城の前で
何たる狼藉！！
この犯罪者どもをひっ捕らえろ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Eek?! C-Criminals?! This is a misunderstanding! We're innocent...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいっ！？　
は、
犯罪者なんて誤解ですっ！
私たちは無実で……

text_block_list.name: Knights of the Royal Palace
text_block_list.text: Zzzzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐがー……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: This situation doesn't exactly give us the innocent look you're going for...
text_block_list.orig_text:
抗えない
無実じゃない感……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: A-At least let's talk first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
話だけでも──

text_block_list.name: Captain of the Royal Knights
text_block_list.text: NO EXPLANATIONS REQUIRED!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 問答無用っ！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *sniffle*... Mm.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すうー……
すぴー……
……ん。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Where am I? The zoo...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
ここどこ？
動物園……？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: We're the ones in a cage, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
檻の中は
うちらだけどな。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sono-chan, why are you looking demonic? You're going to end up getting more wrinkles...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
ソノちゃん鬼みたいな顔してるね～？
小じわが増えちゃうぞ──

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃあああ～～～っっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I'm not getting wrinkles... I'm a kid right now, thank you very much!! As for YOU, what do you think you were doing the moment I took my eyes off you...?! *Grind grind*... *grind grind*....
text_block_list.orig_text:
しわなんて増えるか、
こちとら子どもよ……！
ってか
ちょっと目を離した隙に
何してんのよあんたは……っ！！
ぐりぐり……っ。
ぐりりり……っ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah! Stop grinding my temples!! Help me, Lou-chaaan! This scary old auntie of mine is going to grind me into a nice and proper niece!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぎゃ～、
こめかみぐりぐりやめて～～っ！！
助けてルイちゃ～～～んっ！
この叔母ちゃん、
かわいい姪にぐりぐりしてきます～～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sono-san, calm down! We don't even know if Iroha-chan's the one at fault yet, right?! Let's hear her out first...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ソノさん落ち着いて！
まだイロハちゃんが悪いと決まったわけじゃないでしょ！？
なんであんなことになったか理由を聞かないと……！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: That's right, that's right! In such a situation, you should listen to both sides first, Sono-chan! As expected of the genius Rui-chan! Yo, Your Honor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだそうだっ！
こういう時は
ソウホウの意見を聞くことが大事なんだよ！
さっすがルイちゃんっ！　
よっ、
サイバンチョーっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? "Your Honor"? Ehe. Then, I'll listen to what you have to say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え、
裁判長？
ふふ。
では
言い分を聞いてあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Rui-chan's suddenly got a smug look on her face... Guess being called a judge is a point of pride now... Geez. Fine, Iroha. Speak up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルイちゃんの中で裁判長って
ドヤの対象なんだ……
……ったく。
分かったわよイロハ、
じゃあ話してみ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so...! Iroha was sitting on a bench, minding her own business, you see! Then I heard the sound of swords clashing in the distance, you see! So, you see, I went to check it out, and there were some armored guys practicing, see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
あのね！　
イロハがベンチで座ってたらね！
遠くで剣の音が聞こえたからね！　
行ってみたらね！
鎧のおにーさんたちが
剣のお稽古してたからね！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: So, Iroha joined in and... defeated everyone!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハ混じって、
みんな倒しちゃった！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: JUDGEMENT! The verdict is... Iroha-chan's at fault. Case closed!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
判決！　
1
00対０でイロハちゃんが悪い！！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Tch. C'mon, it was just a little kid's prank at best. Grown-ups should learn to take a joke~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちぇーっ。
なんだよ子どものかわいい冗談じゃん。
大人なら大目に見てほしいよね～

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: No... Iroha-chan, you're the adult here now. It wasn't a kid's prank, it was a rampage by a buxom swordswoman.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや……
イロハちゃん見た目大人だから。
子どものかわいい冗談じゃなくて、
豊満剣士の御乱心だから。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: "Buxom Swordswoman's Rampage"? Awaaah, that sounds just like the title of one of your favourite shameless books, Rui-chan♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ホウマン剣士のゴランシン？
わーっ、
ルイちゃんの大好きな、
破廉恥なご本のタイトルみたーいっ♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wha-...?! Wh-Wh-What are you talking about?! I have zero interest in shameless books, not even a millimeter, thank you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！！？　
なな、
何の事かしら！？！？
破廉恥な本なんて
ミリも興味ありませんけど！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. It's over. I was so excited to have a fresh start... and now I'm locked in a jail cell. The emotional whiplash is so bad, my ears are ringing... not that they actually can, since I'm an elf.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はあ。
終わったな。
新生活に心躍ってたのに
牢屋にぶち込まれるとか。
高低差ありすぎて
耳キーンなるわ、
エルフ耳だからならんけど。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Elven ears don't get that ear-ringing thing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エルフ耳って、
耳キーンならないんだ～？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: No, I made that up.
text_block_list.orig_text: いや適当。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: A-Anyway, let's explain our situation and clear up this misunderstanding first! At the very least, they need to understand nothing malicious was taking place back there...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
とにかく。
ちゃんと事情を話して誤解を解くのが先よ！
悪気はなかったことだけでも分かってもらわないと……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: It'd be a pain if they pryed, I wanted to keep our situation a secret as much as possible... But if we leave it like this, it'll just get worse. Guess we have no choice but to explain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
詮索されたら面倒だから、
できれば隠しておきたかったけど……
このままじゃ事態は悪くしかならないでしょ。
説明するしかないわ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: About how you swapped bodies and minds, Iroha-chan and Sono-san. So even though she looks like an adult, Iroha-chan's really a ten-year-old girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イロハちゃんとソノさんは
心と体が入れ替わってて、
イロハちゃんは大人の体だけど、
ほんとは10歳の女の子だって。

text_block_list.text: Huh...? You mean to say that's the result of some kind of alchemic elixir?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
それって
錬金術のお薬で、
ですか？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. The Forbidden Elixir that switches bodies and minds. Normally, it's an elixir whose effect only lasts a few minutes... but for Iroha-chan and Sono-san it's been about a year now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ええ。
心と体が入れ替わる
『禁断の秘薬』
本当は入れ替わっても数十分で元に戻る薬なの……
でもイロハちゃんとソノさんは
入れ替わってもう一年近く──

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Wait, WHO ARE YOU?!
text_block_list.orig_text: ってあなた誰！？

text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to eavesdrop.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
すみません。
盗み聞きするつもりはなかったのですが。

text_block_list.name: Karin
text_block_list.text: My apologies for the late introduction. My name is Karin, from the Guild Management Association.
text_block_list.orig_text:
申し遅れました。
私は
ギルド管理協会のカリンと申します。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Guild Management Association...?
text_block_list.orig_text: ギルド管理協会……？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ehhh... This green-haired lady looks scary strong. Like demon-level strong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へえ……
この緑のおねーさん。
悪魔みたいに強そうだよ……？

text_block_list.name: Karin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, no need to be on edge. I'm on your side, I promise~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
そう警戒なさらず。
私はみなさんの味方ですから♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Louise Marie, Iroha, and Sono were thrown into jail soon after arriving in Landosol. Their difficult life in the town had just begun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ランドソルに来て早々牢屋に入れられてしまった、
ルイズマリー、
イロハ、
ソノの３人。
前途多難なランドソル生活が幕を開けたのだった。
